title: Ububele obabuzisa uloyiko
intro: Kwisixeko esasigcwele ububi, umkhonzi othembekileyo wamkela iindwendwe ezingalindelekanga ngenye imini. Exhalabele ukhuseleko lwabo, lo mntu wanikela ngokhuseleko, kodwa abantu besixeko bafuna into ehlazisayo. Elumkisiwe ngentshabalalo ezayo, umkhonzi wabaleka nosapho lwakhe ebumnyameni, eshiya ngasemva isixeko esiphawulelwe intshabalalo. Ngubani lo ukholwayo yedwa?
clues: Ndathunywa njengomthunywa kubantu ababenze izenzo ezihlazisayo.
Iindwendwe ebezingalindelekanga zeza ekhayeni lam, kwaye bendixhalabele ukhuseleko lwazo ngaphezu kolwam.
Abantu bam bafuna ukubona iindwendwe zam ngeenjongo ezimbi, ndaza ndazama ukuqiqa nazo.
Iindwendwe zam zaziveza njengeengelosi zaza zandiyalela ukuba ndithathe usapho lwam ndihambe ebusuku.
Umfazi wam akazange aphulaphule ubizo lokubaleka waza wajamelana nentshabalalo efanayo nabantu basekhaya.
Isixeko sam sabhukuqwa yimvula yamatye odongwe olunezitena, iindawo zaso eziphakamileyo zehla zaba zezona ziphantsi.
